memories.content: The president is responsible for organizing club events and making decisions about the pier viewing party. They have not yet decided whether to go ahead with the event.

A partial solar eclipse is scheduled over Marlin Bay on the 12th. The astronomy club is considering a pier viewing party for the eclipse. The president must confirm by the 10th whether the party is going ahead.
